image_description: A high-angle, black-and-white photograph looking down a spiral staircase. The image features a strong geometric pattern created by the repeating curves of the handrails and the radial lines of the steps. The handrail is dark and continuous, supported by thin, vertical balusters that follow the spiral descent. The steps are light-colored, creating high contrast with the dark railing.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a bannister/staircase railing system and not a generic abstract pattern.
Spiral staircases are prone to AI geometric errors (impossible connections, floating steps). This expert will verify the 3D coherence of the descending spiral.
To ensure the handrail is a single continuous object without melting into the background or balusters, and that balusters are distinct entities.
